description: This file defines the RootKeyEncryptionService class, which manages encryption keys, key wrapping, unwrapping, validation, and related cryptographic operations for secure data encryption within the application. It handles key lifecycle, storage, and re-encryption of item keys, integrating with device and storage interfaces.

classes.name: RootKeyEncryptionService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing root encryption keys, including creation, validation, wrapping, unwrapping, storage, and re-encryption of item keys, ensuring secure encryption workflows within the application.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the encryption service, determining key mode based on stored data and setting up the root key if applicable.

methods.name: passcodeUpgradeAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a passcode upgrade is available by comparing current passcode key version with the latest protocol version.

methods.name: hasRootKeyWrapper
methods.description: Determines if a root key wrapper exists in storage.

methods.name: hasAccount
methods.description: Checks if an account root key is present based on current key mode.

methods.name: hasRootKeyEncryptionSource
methods.description: Indicates if there is a valid source for root key encryption (account or passcode).

methods.name: hasPasscode
methods.description: Checks if passcode-based encryption is enabled.

methods.name: getEncryptionSourceVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of the encryption source (account or passcode).

methods.name: getUserVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the user root key if available.

methods.name: getRootKeyFromKeychain
methods.description: Retrieves the root key stored in device keychain.

methods.name: saveRootKeyToKeychain
methods.description: Persists the root key to device keychain.

methods.name: getRootKeyWrapperKeyParams
methods.description: Fetches the root key wrapper parameters from storage.

methods.name: getSureRootKeyWrapperKeyParams
methods.description: Returns the root key wrapper parameters, asserting non-undefined.

methods.name: getRootKeyParams
methods.description: Gets current root key parameters based on key mode.

methods.name: getSureRootKeyParams
methods.description: Returns the root key parameters, asserting non-undefined.

methods.name: computeRootKey
methods.description: Computes a root key from password and key parameters.

methods.name: createRootKey
methods.description: Creates a new root key with specified identifier, password, and version.

methods.name: validateAccountPassword
methods.description: Validates an account password against the stored root key.

methods.name: validatePasscode
methods.description: Validates a passcode against stored key parameters.

methods.name: validateWrappingKey
methods.description: Validates a wrapping key by attempting to decrypt the wrapped root key.

methods.name: wrapAndPersistRootKey
methods.description: Encrypts and stores the root key using a wrapping key.

methods.name: unwrapRootKey
methods.description: Decrypts and sets the root key from wrapped data using a wrapping key.

methods.name: setNewRootKeyWrapper
methods.description: Sets a new root key wrapper, encrypting the root key and updating storage.

methods.name: removeRootKeyWrapper
methods.description: Removes the root key wrapper and stores the root key in keychain.

methods.name: setRootKey
methods.description: Sets a new root key, updating storage and possibly wrapping it.

methods.name: deleteWorkspaceSpecificKeyStateFromDevice
methods.description: Deletes all key data from device and storage, resetting key mode.

methods.name: encrypPayloadWithKeyLookup
methods.description: Encrypts a payload using the current root key.

methods.name: encryptPayloadsWithKeyLookup
methods.description: Encrypts multiple payloads with the current root key.

methods.name: encryptPayload
methods.description: Encrypts a payload with a specified root key.

methods.name: encryptPayloads
methods.description: Encrypts multiple payloads with a specified root key.

methods.name: decryptPayloadWithKeyLookup
methods.description: Decrypts a payload using the current root key.

methods.name: decryptPayload
methods.description: Decrypts a payload with a specified root key.

methods.name: decryptPayloadsWithKeyLookup
methods.description: Decrypts multiple payloads using the current root key.

methods.name: decryptPayloads
methods.description: Decrypts multiple payloads with a specified root key.

methods.name: reencryptItemsKeys
methods.description: Re-encrypts all item keys with the current root key after change.

methods.name: createNewDefaultItemsKey
methods.description: Creates a new default item key, possibly based on root key.

methods.name: createNewItemsKeyWithRollback
methods.description: Creates a new item key with rollback capability.

methods.name: getDiagnostics
methods.description: Provides diagnostic information about root key encryption state.
